population.ranking_representative: one checkpoint nearest the within-owner-family median full-benchmark accuracy

primary_ability_model.name: family-label-free cross-fitted spectral MIRT
primary_ability_model.rank_infeasible_dimensions: omitted separately within each fitting matrix
primary_ability_model.dimension_selection: minimum dimension within one standard error of the lowest owner-held-out and item-held-out predictive Bernoulli log loss

family_dif.item_magnitude: maximum minus minimum conditional family logit effect

anchors.selection: lowest residual family-DIF magnitude within source-by-MIRT-residual-easiness quartile
anchors.inverse_selection_weighting: restore the exact original mass of every selection cell

robustness.dimension_policy: freeze each benchmark-fold dimension chosen in the primary population when changing only the family or owner rule

reporting_commitments: Report all five benchmark outcomes, including null or adverse results.
Treat family effects as observational measurement non-invariance, not causal lineage effects.
Treat the low-DIF score as a diagnostic reweighting rather than a replacement benchmark score.
